title: Grilled Chicken Skewers with American Slaw
description: A refreshing summer dish featuring vibrant chicken skewers paired with a crunchy American-inspired slaw.
instructions: 2. Thread chicken, bell peppers, and onion onto skewers.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
4. Brush skewers with the marinade, making sure to coat all the ingredients.
5. Grill skewers for 10-12 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, prepare the slaw by mixing the American-style coleslaw mix with a squeeze of lemon juice.
7. Serve skewers with slaw on the side and a dollop of your favorite sauce, if desired.
8. Wrap foil around skewers to keep warm and serve immediately.
